faq.title: What people ask me before we start.
faq.lead: Tap a question and I’ll answer.

items.q: Can people tell I made it, not a camera?
items.a: That’s what I work on the most: if it shows, the piece is useless. That’s why the pilot exists: you see ten pieces made for your brand before committing, and if you wouldn’t post them I refund what you paid.

items.q: How much of my time does it take?
items.a: At first, one call to get to know your brand. After that, a few minutes a week to review what I send and approve it or ask for changes.

items.q: Do I have to film myself?
items.a: No. I make the videos with your product and with people created for your brand, filmed the way a customer would film them. If you want to appear, that works too.

items.q: Do you post it for me?
items.a: Your choice. If I post it, you connect your account once to the scheduling tool I use, without giving me your password. If you’d rather post it yourself, I deliver it ready with the copy for each piece.

items.q: What if I don’t like a piece?
items.a: Ask for the change and I fix it that same week. Your brand sheet keeps that change, so you don’t have to ask again.
No. We start with the USD {price} pilot, which comes off your first month if we keep going. After that it’s month to month and you tell me when you want to stop.
